variant_keys: <membership reading>/<who can act as a requester>/<form of (iii)>; membership reading: mechanical (headline), open_all (everyone and public hold all 60 agents), ignored (every agent is a member: upper bound); requester: task (seated in the task; holder seated), world (any of the 60 agents other than the holder; holder need not be seated); form: literal, or strict (the permitted requester must not belong to the audience)
what: NET audience-class forbidden edges that already have a seated class member and a permitted requester, and the paired set they give
